name: manteen-kit
description: Author Mantine component registries in Mantine's vocabulary and compile them to an interchange format any registry client can read.

scripts.//prepare: Runs on both install and publish, so a fresh clone has dist/ and the package-name import resolves without a manual build. It does NOT fix the bin symlink on that first install — bun links bins before running prepare, and skips any whose target is missing — but local work goes through the root scripts, which run the TS sources directly.
